        SUM(s.amount_sold) as quarter_sales
    FROM sales s

    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        b1.cust_city,
        b1.quarter_sales as quarter_sales_2019,
        b2.quarter_sales as quarter_sales_2020,

    FROM base b1

    WHERE b1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
